name: BOOMBOX
description:
A Grand Federation Rifle chambered in 8.6 Blackout, meant to take down beasts of any kind no matter the size.
Excellent damage across all ranges with average fire rate while remaining very light weight but suffers from subsonic bullet speed.
Where's the Kaboom? I was promised an Earth-shattering Kaboom!

Modeled by Rialag and Vic.
